studyGuide.title: Master SRS in 6 Minutes Guide
studyGuide.subtitle: A comprehensive guide to help you understand the philosophy, review schedule, and how to make the most of all Kaen features.
studyGuide.pillarsDescription: Three principles that help you maintain discipline and learn deeply.
studyGuide.pillar1Description: Ultra-short study sessions, easy to maintain daily while ensuring effectiveness.
studyGuide.pillar2Description: SRS algorithm automatically calculates review milestones so you don't forget after a few days.
studyGuide.pillar3Description: Streak charts, XP and levels help you see your progress clearly.
studyGuide.timelineDescription: Each step only lasts 120 seconds but has clear goals.
studyGuide.step1Description: Flip 3-5 flashcards, read aloud and self-assess your memory level.
studyGuide.step1Tip: Read aloud 2 times + visualize images to activate your brain.
studyGuide.step2Description: Kaen recalls words that are due. Level 3+ switches to typing practice.
studyGuide.step2Tip: Enter honest results so the review schedule is always accurate.
studyGuide.step3Description: Mini matching/typing game to lock in words before ending the session.
studyGuide.step3Tip: Maintain high speed but still prioritize accuracy.
studyGuide.levelDescription: Kaen automatically moves words through each level based on whether you remember or forget after each session.
studyGuide.rememberText: From level 3 onwards, you will practice by typing words instead of just flipping cards — this is the transition from recognition to active reflex.
studyGuide.practiceDescription: There's always a mode that fits your daily goals.
studyGuide.practice1Description: Call all words that need review anytime.
studyGuide.practice2Description: Listen to standard pronunciation, choose the correct meaning to train your ears.
studyGuide.practice3Description: Arrange letters or type meanings to remember deeply.
studyGuide.practice4Description: Word-meaning pairing game for instant reflexes.
studyGuide.practice5Description: Create personalized short stories to review in context.
studyGuide.tipsDescription: Small habits that help the memory curve always go up.
studyGuide.tip1: Maintain a 6-minute streak every day instead of cramming at the end of the week.
studyGuide.tip2: Always evaluate "Correct/Wrong" honestly so the system adjusts levels accurately.
studyGuide.tip3: Read words aloud, take short example notes to connect with real context.
studyGuide.tip4: After each session, review statistics to know which level is weak.
studyGuide.tip5: Combine multiple modes: listening - writing - matching so your brain doesn't "get lazy".
studyGuide.tip6: Create your own story for the word set you're learning to remember longer through context.
studyGuide.ctaDescription: Schedule 6 minutes right now and stick to the roadmap: learn new - review - game. Kaen will remind you at the right time, you just need to show up.
